pivHint: My HELP comes from the Lord, the Psalmist says. Another word for a lift or bit of assistance is a ______.
winText: You found it. HELP isn't just what comes from the Lord — a BOOST is another word for a lift or bit of assistance.
lossText: The word was BOOST. HELP was the pivot — a BOOST is another way of saying help or a lift, like giving someone a boost over a fence. BOOST is also what a rocket gets at liftoff.
votdVerse: My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.
passageText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth. He will not let your foot slip— he who watches over you will not slumber; indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. The Lord watches over you— the Lord is your shade at your right hand; the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night. The Lord will keep you from all harm— he will watch over your life; the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.
